title: Szechuan Green Beans and Pork

ingredientGroups.title: Szechuan Sauce
items: ¼ tsp dark soy sauce (for color)
2 tsp szechuan peppercorn, cracked or crushed
4 dry red chili peppers, seeded and roughly chopped

ingredientGroups.title: Finishing Sauce
items: 1 Tbsp Chinkiang Vinegar (chinese black vinegar, or substitute Apple cider vinegar)

steps: Add 1-2 Tbsp neutral oil to a preheated wok and stir fry over high heat the string beans in two batches until they are slightly wrinkled with a light amount of surface char. Set aside.
Reduce the heat and stir fry the ginger, onions, and garlic until fragrant, approximately 30-60 seconds.
Add the ground pork, turning the heat back up to high, and sear until no longer pink.
Add the Szechuan sauce, stirring for 2-3 minutes to evaporate some of the liquid.
Add the green beans and saute until desired tenderness.
Add the finishing sauce, stir briefly to incorporate, then serve over white rice.
